Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her pretty dress and play outside in the sun. One day, Lily saw a big, scary dog running towards her. She got scared and ran back to her mommy.

Her mommy found her and said, "Don't worry, Lily. The big dog is friendly." Lily felt better and they continued to play together.
